description: Automatic VM/LXC discovery, running/stopped/unknown state, guest allocations and usage, and summaries by actual Proxmox node. Uses existing pve-exporter metrics only. Physical-host CPU, RAM, storage and hardware health belong to Host Systems and Disk Health.

panels.title: Proxmox scrape health
panels.description: Collection state for the selected API instance. Stale, absent or duplicate scrapes are Unknown; this does not prove complete API permissions.

targets.expr: min(up{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) and on() (count(up{job="pve",instance="$instance"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(timestamp(up{job="pve",instance="$instance"})) < $pve_freshness_s)

panels.title: Discovered VMs and LXCs
panels.description: Current API-visible entries matching the filters, including templates. This is discovered inventory, not an expected-service list.

targets.expr: count(max by(job,instance,id,node,name,type,template,tags) (pve_guest_info{job="pve",instance="$instance",id=~"qemu/.+|lxc/.+",node=~"$guest_node",type=~"$guest_type"}))
